Experienced skydivers jump from 13,500 feet with modern Twin Otter aircraft

Maximum weight 250 lbs, surcharge $35 per 10 lbs over 220 lbs up to 250 lbs
Reasonably good health; consult physician if medical conditions
AADs required for experienced jumpers with reserve card within 180 days

blurb: Guests can book tandem skydives from 14,000 feet with video/photo packages available. Experienced skydivers have access to modern facilities, gear rental, and a vibrant community with events and training. High altitude jumps above 15,000 feet with supplemental oxygen are also offered for advanced skydivers.
extraNote: Weather dependent; cancellations due to weather rescheduled free of charge · Payments non-refundable; deposits transferable if rescheduled 24+ hours in advance · No call/no show forfeits deposit · Arrive at check-in time; late arrival loses slot but pays for jump · Year-round with holiday break mid-Dec to mid-Jan

quotes.text: Experience was amazing from start to finish. The staff checking me in to the team on the jump absolute pleasure to deal with, Great people and great personalities loads of fun. I’m trying to leave a good review but can’t unless I have access my email but when I do I will leave you a great review. Thank you all so so much I felt very safe and confident on the jump

This was my first time skydiving and I had the BEST experience!! I got really scared when we were in the plane and the door opened but Zach talked me through the whole thing and I ended up jumping and it was one of the most amazing things I’ve ever done!! I would recommend anyone who wants to skydive to go to Skydive Orange!!

Outstanding, Everything from check in, meeting my Tandem Instructor, the aircraft, and the jump itself was an amazing experience. This was my fourth time tandem jumping and Skydive Orange is the best! We had a group of 8 people and everyone said the same thing. Don't ever change.
I had the best time at Skydive Orange. I highly recommend asking for Zach, his professionalism, experience, and personality are unmatched. This will be a memory i have for a lifetime.
I had the best experience ever! Our instructors were very cool guys( special mine Joseph you're the best 😎) definitely would go again! Thank you

quotes.author: Ben Vickers
quotes.text: Ben Vickers Radford, VA The first time you skydive is a tremendous event in your life. And I am so lucky to have found Skydive Orange.
